$comment: site.consent is the consent mechanism the site has wired (SC-030): on WordPress a WP Consent API plugin, on Next.js its own consent store. With one wired, the footer draws the consent control, aria-disabled="true" as the server draws it until script hydrates (SC-024), with its status line; the panel is closed, so its dialog is not drawn.
summary: A consent mechanism is wired, so the footer draws the consent preferences control after the copyright line, closed and not yet hydrated.
